decision: GO FOR REVIEWED NONROOT PACKAGE STAGING SCOPE
reviewedControls: Fixed nonroot administration identity; no path overrides in CLI.
Exact reviewed transport SHA plus compressed, raw, index and immutable executable hashes.
Fourteen exact allowed files: thirteen code/config/public-status/usage payloads and one index.
Received compressed content and decompressed aggregate are bounded; files are regular owner-held with one link and no symlink following.
Existing stage files must match exact bytes; unrelated or changed files are preserved and cause refusal.
Fresh available-disk reserve is enforced before directory creation, before each write, and after all writes.
Every staged file is reread; directory and file data are fsynced.
Only original-service read-only metadata is checked before/after; no Node execution, financial database, credentials, market request or service mutation.
reviewFindingResolved: Initial helper lacked fresh disk reserve checks. Added total payload plus 512MiB admission guard and per-file/final checks; boundary test proves refusal before stage directory creation.
limitations: No actual EC2 staging or cutover executed by this review.
Lead must freeze the exact reviewed source and transport/index hashes after completing the root SQLite ownership correction.
Staging bytes does not establish original-account migration, service operation or reporting acceptance.
